info.description:
SVN administration API. The service is reachable only from RFC1918 networks and, from P1, requires a bearer session token.
Error responses always use {"error":{"code":"...","message":"..."}}.
info.title: SVN Admin API

get.description: Checks that the SVN parent directory is usable and the auth/access files exist.
Every non-groups section of the authz file, with its ACL. Principals are returned verbatim so $authenticated, $anonymous and &aliases stay visible.

post.description: Appends a `<repo>:/<path>` section. The path must match ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}:/.*$ and must not contain '..', NUL, a control character or a backslash.

parameters.description: sha256 of the authz file the edit is based on
parameters.name: If-Match

409.description: the path already exists or the file changed

delete.description: Removes the section and every ACL entry in it.

get.description: The path segment is the URL-safe base64 encoding of values such as project:/trunk; ?path= is accepted instead.

put.description: Writes `principal = permission` for a user, an @group or `*`. The permission is none, r or rw; none removes the line. $authenticated, $anonymous and &aliases are read-only and rejected with 422.

parameters.description: sha256 of the authz file the edit is based on
parameters.name: If-Match

delete.description: Deletes every line for the principal. Removing an entry that is already absent is a no-op. Read-only principals are rejected with 422.

post.description: Appends a `name =` line to the [groups] block without rewriting any other line. The name must match ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$.

parameters.description: sha256 of the authz file the edit is based on
parameters.name: If-Match

409.description: the group already exists or the file changed

get.description: Returns the group members and the access paths whose ACL references the group.

delete.description: Removes every `name =` line from [groups] and every `@name` entry from access-path sections. Users with the same name are never touched.

get.summary: List the access paths that reference a group
Read the members of a group

put.description: Rewrites only the matching `[groups]` line. The submitted users replace the previous member list; every name is validated.
put.summary: Replace the members of a group

parameters.description: sha256 of the authz file the edit is based on
parameters.name: If-Match

get.description: Lists the directories under SVNParentPath that contain format, db/ and conf/, so stray directories are not reported as repositories.

post.description: Runs `svnadmin create --fs-type fsfs` in the first writable SVNParentPath, optionally commits the standard layout ("single" = trunk/branches/tags, "multi" = <projectName>/trunk|branches|tags) and optionally creates the `<name>:/` authz section. The owner of the new repository is the service uid; nothing is chowned.

409.description: a repository with this name already exists

500.description: svnadmin failed; the failed step is reported

501.description: the Subversion CLI is not configured in this deployment

delete.description: Moves the repository into SVN_ADMIN_TRASH_DIR (default `<data>/trash`) as `<repo>-<UTC20060102T150405Z>`; never removes data recursively. The caller must repeat the repository name in `confirm`. Cross-filesystem moves are refused with 409 and need a manual move. Deletion is enabled by default and disabled with SVN_ADMIN_REPO_DELETE_ENABLED=false.

409.description: the repository is on another filesystem than the trash directory

422.description: confirm does not match the repository name

get.description: HEAD revision plus the last-changed revision, author and date. HEAD comes from `svn log -r HEAD --limit 1`; `svn info` supplies the last change, because its entry revision is not the repository HEAD.

501.description: the Subversion CLI is not configured in this deployment

get.description: Runs `svn list --xml` and returns one page of entries. `path` must be relative and must not contain '.' or '..' segments; `rev` is a positive revision number, empty means HEAD. Entries are sorted by name before paging (default 100, max 1000). Subversion stderr and filesystem paths are never returned.

parameters.description: relative directory path; empty means the repository root
parameters.name: path

501.description: the Subversion CLI is not configured in this deployment

get.description: Returns the authenticated user. The token itself is never echoed back.

post.description: Verifies the htpasswd credentials and returns an opaque bearer token. Only the single account recorded in the administrator file may sign in; other valid accounts receive 403 not_administrator. The token is only returned here and by POST /session/refresh; it is never set as a cookie. Five attempts per minute per client IP are allowed.

403.description: not_administrator: valid credentials but not the administrator, or the source address is not allowed

503.description: setup_required: no administrator has been recorded yet

delete.description: Revokes the bearer token. The call is idempotent and returns 204 with no body.

post.description: Issues a new token and revokes the presented one immediately, so the old token can never be used again. The account must still be the administrator; otherwise the new token is revoked and the call returns 403 not_administrator.

Requires the one-time bootstrap token from SVN_ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN (or the token printed to stderr at startup). The chosen account is written to the single-line administrator file and becomes the only account allowed to sign in to the management API. When the account does not exist yet a password is required and the account is created; when it exists the password is ignored. On a fresh deployment the marker is overwritten; once the marker exists, moving the administrator is a manual file edit. Missing auth/access/admin files are created. Other API routes answer 503 setup_required until this succeeds.

parameters.description: account name, optional password and bootstrap token
parameters.name: request

422.description: invalid account name or missing/invalid password

500.description: the write failed; a freshly created account is rolled back

503.description: storage_unavailable: the auth/access/admin directory is missing or not writable

get.description: Public diagnostic used by the login page. It reports whether the single administrator still has to be created, why (missing_auth_file, missing_access_file, no_users, no_admin), and whether the auth/access/admin files are usable. It never exposes absolute paths, password hashes, file contents or the administrator account name. The users list is only populated while setup is pending.
Service version, Go runtime and the state of the configured SVN paths. File contents are never returned. Requires a valid bearer token.
Paged list of htpasswd accounts with their groups. Password hashes are never returned.

post.description: Adds a `user:$apr1$...` line to the htpasswd file without disturbing any other line. The password is hashed inside the store and never returned or logged.

delete.description: Removes the account from every authz group, every access-path ACL and finally the htpasswd file. The steps run in that order; a failure returns 500 with the steps that already completed. `*` is rejected.

get.description: Returns every source of access: direct user entries, entries inherited through the account's groups and the global `*` entry. inherited is true for the last two; source is user, group or global.
get.summary: List the effective access paths of an account
Read the authz groups of an account

put.description: Edits only the necessary `[groups]` lines of the authz file. Every submitted group must already exist; unknown groups are rejected with 422.
put.summary: Replace the group membership of an account

parameters.description: sha256 of the authz file the edit is based on
parameters.name: If-Match

put.description: Rewrites only the target htpasswd line with a fresh APR1 hash and revokes every token of that account, including the caller's own token when they rotate their own password. Every authenticated operator may change any account password.

parameters.description: sha256 of the credentials file the edit is based on
parameters.name: If-Match

409.description: the file changed since it was read

bearerAuth.description: Bearer session token returned by POST /svnadmin/api/v1/session, e.g. "Bearer svna_...".
bearerAuth.name: Authorization
